hero_lede: Pick a group and subject, then open a road. Content comes from data files — not hard-coded UI.
empty_catalog: No roads in this catalog yet.
login_lede: Enter your email and we send you a one-time 8-digit code. New users register with a first name, last name, and email. No password.
record_hint: Optional recording — if the browser supports it.
stats_message: Great job — you finished the road!
stats_message_retry: Worth revisiting a few steps to strengthen.
gate_practice: Finish this step before moving on.
empty_tab: No roads in this tab yet.
home_tabs_lede: Tabs show roads you started, finished, or should revisit. The full catalog stays available.
login_email_note: The cookie stores only an opaque id. Email is an identity, not a password.
err_name_required: First and last name are required.
err_email_taken: That email is already registered — try again or check the details.
err_email_change_disabled: Your sign-in email can only be changed with “Change email” below (codes to both addresses).
add_path_gate_lede: Add-road builds a full learning road with an agent. Grok is reached through Cloudflare AI Gateway; the xAI key stays in Cloudflare Secrets Store (BYOK). MyRoad never accepts that key.
add_path_criterion_met: Cloudflare AI Gateway is configured and responded. No provider API key was sent by MyRoad.
add_path_next_steps: Fill in the goal to start building. You or the agent can publish.
security_note_body: MyRoad does not accept, store, or send an xAI or other provider API key. Keys stay in Cloudflare Secrets Store. This POC does not persist secrets in the database, cookies, localStorage, or logs.
add_path_not_configured_hint: Add the xAI key once in the Cloudflare dashboard as BYOK alias default. MyRoad only needs the account id and gateway name in the server environment.
err_gateway_not_configured: Cloudflare AI Gateway is not configured. Set CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_GATEWAY_ID on the server. Do not paste an xAI API key into MyRoad.
err_gateway_request: Cloudflare AI Gateway request failed. Check the gateway and the BYOK xAI key in the Cloudflare dashboard, not in MyRoad.
login_new_lede: First name, last name, and a unique email. No password.
login_have_account: Already registered? Sign in with email
settings_lede: Name, email, and interface language. Language is chosen here only.
locked_read_only: You can look inside in read-only mode. Answers and progress are not saved.
read_only_blocked: Read-only: finish the earlier road first to answer and save progress.
builder_lede: Describe a goal. The agent drafts an outline, fills each topic, and saves a draft you can review and publish.
builder_gateway_ready: Grok is reached through Cloudflare AI Gateway (BYOK). The server environment is set.
builder_missing_env: Cloudflare AI Gateway is not configured. Missing on the server: {names}. Do not paste an xAI API key into MyRoad.
builder_demo_offer: You can still try the whole flow in demo mode: it builds a full Hebrew sample draft (12+ stages) without Cloudflare. Demo drafts are labeled as demo.
builder_goal_hint: For example: fractions for beginners, or the present simple tense.
builder_mode_demo: Demo mode (no model call, Hebrew sample)
builder_err_goal: Please write a goal of at least 3 characters and pick valid options.
builder_existing_lede: Published roads in {subject}. Open one, or continue to a new draft.
builder_existing_none: No published roads in this subject yet.
builder_outline_lede: Check the outline. You can edit titles and order, then approve to start building.
builder_err_outline_edit: The edited outline is not valid. Titles cannot be empty.
builder_build_lede: One model call per topic. Each topic is saved to the draft as soon as it is filled.
gen_err_gateway_not_configured: Cloudflare AI Gateway is not configured on the server. Use demo mode or set the gateway variables.
gen_err_gateway_request: The Cloudflare AI Gateway call failed ({detail}). Check the gateway and the BYOK key in the Cloudflare dashboard, then try again.
gen_err_bad_reply: The model reply could not be used, even after one repair attempt: {detail}. Try again.
gen_err_save_failed: The draft could not be saved ({detail}).
gen_err_internal: Something went wrong while building ({detail}). Try again.
gen_err_short_bad_reply: Model reply was not valid JSON
builder_complete_ok: The road is complete: at least 3 topics and 12 stages, and every topic has explanation, practice, and check.
builder_publish_note: You or the agent may publish. The published version is never changed; feedback creates a new draft.
builder_published_ok: Published. The road is now in the catalog and plays in the player.
builder_feedback_lede: Feedback creates a new draft version. The published version stays as it is.
builder_feedback_topic: Rebuild a topic with this feedback
builder_feedback_whole: No rebuild, just record it on the new draft
builder_nothing_built: No topic has been built yet.
draft_problems_none: No problems found in the draft so far.
draft_problem_review_kind_invalid: Step “{title}” has review topics but is not a valid review step (kind “{kind}”).
draft_problem_review_topic_unknown: Review step “{title}” mixes a topic that does not exist in the road: {topic}.
draft_problem_review_topic_not_earlier: Review step “{title}” mixes topic {topic}, which does not come earlier in the road.
draft_problem_missing_title_he: The road has no Hebrew title (titles.he).
draft_problem_missing_blurb_he: The road has no Hebrew description (blurbs.he).
draft_problem_bad_subject: The road has no valid subject: “{subject}”.
draft_problem_no_nodes: The road has no steps yet.
draft_problem_node_correct_missing: Step “{title}” has answer choices but no correct answer.
draft_problem_node_correct_not_in_choice: Step “{title}”: the correct answer “{correct}” is not one of the choices ({choices}).
draft_problem_node_invalid: Step “{title}” has content that is not valid.
draft_problem_topic_unknown_nodes: Topic “{topic}” points to steps that do not exist: {ids}.
builder_publish_blocked: Publishing is blocked by format errors ({count}). Fix them and try again:
login_code_lede: If {email} can sign in, we sent a 8-digit code to it. A code works once and expires in 15 minutes.
login_code_hint: You can paste the code from the email, spaces included.
login_code_restart: Use a different email or send a new code
err_code_required: Enter the 8-digit code from the email.
err_code_wrong: That code is not correct. Try again.
err_code_expired: The code expired. Request a new one.
err_code_used: That code was already used. Request a new one.
err_code_locked: Too many wrong tries. Request a new code.
err_too_many_codes: Too many codes were requested for this email. Wait 15 minutes, or sign in from a device you used before.
err_mail_failed: We could not send the email. Try again later.
builder_match_found: Existing roads that fit your goal ({count}). Open one, or build a new road anyway:
builder_match_prereqs_done: you already finished what it requires
err_code_slow_down: Too many wrong tries from here. Wait a little and try again.
err_captcha_required: Please complete the check and try again.
err_account_limited: Too many wrong codes for this email today. Try again later, or sign in from a device you used before.
settings_email_change_pending: To change {current} to {new}, enter the code sent to each address. Your email stays the same until both codes check out.
settings_email_changed: Your email was changed. Other devices were signed out.
series_home_lede: The level check opens the road that closes the gap. Each finished road opens the next. Inside a road the track is one tile per row.
series_lede: The check decides where you start. The road marked “start here” is the gap. Earlier roads stay open for review. A locked road opens only after the gap before it is closed.
series_missing: This road is not in the catalog yet.
reduce_motion: Reduce motion (no page animations or smooth scrolling)
reading_prefs_note: Saved on this device only. Changes apply right away.
stats_next_catalog: Pick your next road from the catalog, or replay this one to strengthen it.
explain_lang_note: Some explanations in this road are only available in {lang}.
offline_answer_not_sent: You seem to be offline, so your answer wasn't sent. Check your connection and tap your answer again.
metrics_trend_empty: Not enough answers for a graph yet.
math_series_lede: An opening check, then twelve stages. Each stage opens only after the one before it. The closing check opens only at the end. Every stage has three levels: basics, application, mastery.
tv_goal_sample: finish by the end of the month
tv_rec_sub: Each road with a clear goal
tv_skills_lede: Ticks on each bar are level thresholds. Suggested = a skill the road does not define yet.
rs_q_ph: Road name or what it teaches
rs_empty_p: Try another word or clear some filters.
placement_hint: We found your gap. Keep going from here, step by step. The full path is always up top.
letter_forms_nojoin: Does not join the next letter
scratch_hint: Just for you. Saved on this device only, never sent or checked.
speak_no_voice: This device has no voice for this language, so read aloud is silent. You can read the text and keep going.
speak_unsupported: This browser does not support read aloud. You can read the text and keep going.
eng_start_none: No starting point yet. The road begins at the first stage.
eng_start_before: Your starting point: before the first stage of this road
eng_start_past: Your starting point: past the last stage of this road
eng_week_met: You reached this week's days goal.
eng_week_open: Every day with a short session counts. The week is still open.
eng_week_goal_legend: How many days a week suit you
eng_skills_none: The first skill you master will appear here.
fb_pick_solution: Pick the marked answer to continue.
fb_wrong_lead: Not quite. Here is how to solve it:
pr_gap_title: Your gap: we'll practise more here
offline_body: This page didn't load because there is no connection. Your progress is saved on the server. Try again when you're back online.
register_legal_note: Before you sign up you can read the
privacy_lede: What we keep when you learn on MyRoad, and why. Short, with no fine print.
privacy_account_p: Your first name, last name and email address, entered when you sign up. Your sign in code is sent to that email. We also keep your progress on each road, so you can pick up at the same stage and see what you have done. You can correct your name in settings.
privacy_log_p: We keep a log of taps, answers and screen timings: every answer you enter, every tap, when you move between screens and how long you take to answer. Each log entry carries only a pseudonymous ID, with no name and no email address.
privacy_log_note: A pseudonymous ID is still linked to you, so this is still personal data. That is why we tell you about it here.
privacy_why_p: To make learning better: to see where learners get stuck, which stage is too long and where an explanation has a gap, and to fix the road.
privacy_keep_p: Retention: we keep the account and the usage log while the account is open, and for 30 days after it closes. Where data is stored and who processes it: only on our own server. There is no outside analytics tool.
privacy_contact_h: Who is responsible and how to reach us
privacy_contact_p: Data controller: Eliot. To see, correct or delete your data: eli4056-3ery4h@mail.grokbot.com.
terms_lede: The short rules for using MyRoad.
terms_service_p: MyRoad is a learning platform for adults. It is still a trial, so things may change or not work as expected. Use is free for now.
terms_account_p: You sign up with a name and email address and sign in with a one time code sent by email. Keep access to your inbox safe: whoever gets the code can sign in.
terms_use_p: Use the service to learn. Do not try to break into it, overload it or harm other learners.
terms_content_p: The content is meant to help you learn and does not promise a result in any test or exam.
terms_privacy_p: What we keep and why is in the privacy notice.
terms_more_p: Operator: Eliot, at eli4056-3ery4h@mail.grokbot.com. Governing law: the law of the State of Israel, and the courts of Israel.
tl_lede: Each stage of the track holds a few tiles. Your stage is open, and you can open any stage to see its tiles.
tl_lede_linear: Tiles open in order. The first open tile is your gap. A finished tile can be opened again.
tl_finished: Every tile on this road is done.
tl_done_title: All {total} tiles on this road are done
tl_done_note: Every tile stays open in the track below, to revisit any time.
road_style_timeline_note: Every stage on one line, with clear progress.
road_style_journey_note: Stepping stones in a field, with your progress marked.
jy_lede: The whole road on one screen, as stepping stones in a field. Your stone is marked, and you can open any unlocked tile.
road_orient_legend: How the path scrolls on a wide screen
road_orient_horizontal_note: On a wide screen the path runs sideways and you scroll along it.
road_orient_narrow_note: On a narrow screen the path stays vertical.
